sanskrit: dakṣiṇadvāravāme tu bhṛṅgiṇe tu samarcayet paścimadvāravāme tu vṛṣabhāya namontakam uttaradvāravāme tu gaurīñcaiva tu pūjayet tattaddhyānamanusmṛtya arcayettu gurottamaḥ tatvadṛṣṭyā viśeṣeṇākṣepamatha śāstrakaiḥ ghaṇṭāntu tāḍayeddhīmān tri * kāraṃ yathā kuru dehālyamadhyame caiva astramantrāṇi pūjayet yāgamaṇṭapakaṃ pūrve bhūmitatvena pūjayet agnitatve namontañca bandheṣu yajanaṃ kramāt namamākāśatatvañca sthūṇānāṃ pūjayettataḥ vāsukāyāṃ namontañca darbhamālā supūjayet tannāmnena samabhyarcya pādyādīnyupacārakaiḥ śrīvatsaṃ svastikañcaiva tannāmneti pūjayet evaṃ krameṇa saṃpūjya śuddhatatvena bhāvayet astreṇa dravyaśuddhiñca ātmānaṃ pūjayettataḥ vinyaset hastena dharmādibhirmantrayet karṇikāyai namo'ntañca mantrāṇāñca smaran guruḥ abhimantritapuṃsañca jñānakhaḍgañca saṅgṛhet pañcagavyakrameṇaiva sādhayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ tadvaitañca viśeṣeṇa paridhānādyalaṅkṛtam nirīkṣaṇaprokṣaṇañcaiva tāṭanābhyukṣaṇaṃ tathā kuṭṭanaṃ secanañcaiva mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā pū * nā rekhayā caiva catuṣpadvīni trikṣipet phālacandanasiddhāsyaiḥ bhasmadūrvākṣatān kuśān kuśakūrcañca saṃgrāhya vardhanyā mūrdhni vinyaset
vāme tu varddhanīñcaiva paścimānanameva ca kumbhe mūrdhni ca vinyasya śivaṃ sāṅgañca pūjayet pāśupatāstramūrtī ca pūrvavaddhyānasaṃyutam
